players.knownFor: Killing longshots on impact and losing possession after kickoff flair attempts
players.personality: A woman-built midfielder with the physique of Alisha Lehmann and the passing vision of prime De Bruyne — if De Bruyne played with 300 ping and a broken right analog stick. Still somehow the team's lifeline when everything's collapsing.
players.signature: The laggy kickoff skill move into immediate turnover

players.knownFor: Either thunderous finishes or chair-threatening misses
players.personality: A powerhouse striker built like a freight train — fast, strong, and furious. Feeds off Jan's passes but occasionally forgets passing exists. Complains, scores, rages — repeat.
players.signature: The rage-induced power shot that either obliterates the net or the living room

players.knownFor: Legendary whipped crosses from 2023 that he won't shut up about

funnyStats.Dribbling: 2/5 (depends on the Wi-Fi and the moon phase)

players.personality: A tiny winger with the heart of Mbappé but the strength of a breadstick. Either dribbles like Messi or like a Roomba. Passes when he shouldn't, ignores when he should, and every goal he scores defies physics. Shouts 'THAT'S MINE' before every lost header.
players.signature: The gravity-defying bullshit goal from impossible angles

players.knownFor: Building tiki-taka until one risky ping sends Fortza into a meltdown

funnyStats.Team Spirit: 5/5 (there through wins, losses, and lag spikes)

players.personality: Man City fan to the bone and the self-proclaimed Rodri regen. A rock-solid CDM who builds tiki-taka like it's the Champions League final — until he loses it. Loves a risky pinged pass just a little too much, but when the team's winning, he's cooking. Always ready to take the blame.
players.signature: The risky ping that either starts a counterattack or gifts the opponent a goal

players.knownFor: Poetic insults and longshot merchant energy
players.personality: The silky winger with mafia energy and a PhD in passing praise. A longshot merchant who talks like a FIFA commentator mid-match — especially when he screws it up himself. His dribbling's smooth, his passing divine, and his insults are poetic. Once part of the legendary Scawwy Lads trio with Jan and Cama, he still carries that prime aura — and that temper.
players.signature: The top bins longshot while screaming poetic Irish curses

players.knownFor: 'KEEP UP THE PRESS!' echoing even when offline
players.personality: A commanding CDM and the squad's unofficial manager, motivator, and occasional myth. Loves a pinged over-the-top through ball and runs the midfield like a drill sergeant — until he forgets to run for himself. When he's present, the team flows. When he's missing… it's chaos.
players.signature: The over-the-top through ball with 'KEEP UP THE PRESS!' voice crack

players.knownFor: Occasionally forgetting which side of the pitch she's on
players.personality: A returning FIFA veteran who never lost the sauce. When she's locked in, crosses are pinpoint and passes are buttery smooth. Her character Spidey moves fast, talks in third person, and brings pure vibes to the VC. Goals? Optional. Energy? Mandatory.
players.signature: The pinpoint cross from the wrong wing

players.knownFor: Permanently residing in an offside position

funnyStats.Shooting: 2/5 (you'll never see it coming — neither will he)

players.personality: The team's lovable noob. Still learning the controls, occasionally forgets which button shoots, and permanently resides in an offside position. But every now and then, out of nowhere — he scores. Nobody knows how, not even him. Brings confusion, comedy, and the occasional miracle finish.
players.signature: The accidental banger from an offside position that somehow counts
